notes.title: VectorWars VR on Sale until July 5th
notes.notes:
[img] http://www.redironlabs.com/Downloads/Steam/Steam-VectorWarsUpdate.jpg [/img]

VectorWars VR is on sale now as part of Steam's Summer Sale. 

VectorWars VR is an overhead spaceshooter with a tabletop feel. Fight of hordes of alien ships as you collect power-ups and upgrades, to fight back and save humanity. 
The game uses a unique cross-platform score system, allowing you to compete with other players internationally for the highest score.

notes.title: VectorWars has Launched!
notes.notes:
[img] http://www.redironlabs.com/Downloads/Steam/Steam-VectorWarsUpdate.jpg [/img]

[h1]We are proud to announce that VectorWars has released! [/h1]

Wow, what an incredible week we have had.  

It has taken a lot of work to get this game prepped and ready for VR.

We've done a lot of testing for both VR and non-VR players - but bugs sometimes come up that we have missed.  So please, let us know if you see anything weird!

We want to keep making this game amazing, so keep us posted on things you loved or didn't like :).
